title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: The Jeffersons

The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.
